title: Improve volunteer onboarding for a fictional community garden network

organization.name: Northstar Community Gardens
organization.context: A synthetic organization coordinating five imaginary neighborhood gardens.

challenge: New volunteers often attend one orientation but do not complete a first garden shift, limiting the network's ability to staff weekend activities.
desired_outcomes: Increase the share of oriented volunteers who complete a first shift.
Make onboarding consistent across all five fictional gardens.
Reduce coordination effort for volunteer garden leads.
constraints: Use only existing fictional staff and volunteer roles.
Do not introduce paid software during the first six months.
Keep the onboarding process accessible from a mobile phone.
available_evidence: Synthetic baseline: 120 people attended orientation last season.
Synthetic baseline: 42 of those people completed a first shift.
Synthetic interview theme: volunteers were unsure which shift suited beginners.
